name: tsx-lvgl
description: Typed TSX interfaces compiled to native LVGL for small screens

scripts.simulator:build: npm run build && cmake -S apps/simulator -B "${TSX_LVGL_SIMULATOR_BUILD_DIR:-build/simulator}" -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug && cmake --build "${TSX_LVGL_SIMULATOR_BUILD_DIR:-build/simulator}" --parallel
scripts.simulator:test: npm run simulator:build && mkdir -p "${TSX_LVGL_SIMULATOR_BUILD_DIR:-build/simulator}/evidence" && SDL_VIDEODRIVER=dummy SDL_RENDER_DRIVER=software TSX_LVGL_TEST=1 TSX_LVGL_SCREENSHOT_DIR="${TSX_LVGL_SIMULATOR_BUILD_DIR:-build/simulator}/evidence" "${TSX_LVGL_SIMULATOR_BUILD_DIR:-build/simulator}/tsx_lvgl_simulator"
scripts.esp-idf:v1:build: npm run build && NINJAFLAGS=-j2 idf.py -C apps/esp-idf-v1 build && idf.py -C apps/esp-idf-v1 size
scripts.mutation: npm run build && npm run mutation:legacy && npm run mutation:mvp
